name: Black Widow
summary: A spy so good she switched sides and kept the whole skill set. Natasha Romanova started as a Soviet agent hounding Iron Man and became one of the most dependable Avengers.
origin: Natasha's first job in comics was to ruin Tony Stark's week. She arrived in Tales of Suspense #52 in 1964 as a Soviet agent sent to sabotage Iron Man, and it took a couple of years of shifting loyalties before she landed with the heroes for good. Her famous black catsuit came along in The Amazing Spider-Man #86 in 1970. She has no flashy powers: a Soviet take on the super-soldier program slowed her aging and toughened her immune system, and everything else is training in espionage, marksmanship and hand-to-hand fighting. Honestly, that makes her scarier than half the people with powers she works alongside.
powers: Crack shot with almost any weapon
Slowed aging and a hardy immune system

storyline.title: Soviet spy
storyline.beat: Natasha Romanoff first appears in Tales of Suspense as a Soviet agent sent to sabotage Tony Stark. She has no costume and plays a classic Cold War villain role.

storyline.title: Hawkeye and defection
storyline.beat: She draws a young Hawkeye into crime against Iron Man, but over the next few years she breaks with her Soviet masters and starts working with the heroes.

storyline.title: The black catsuit
storyline.beat: In The Amazing Spider-Man #86 she debuts the sleek black costume and wrist-mounted stingers that define her look from then on.

storyline.title: Partners in San Francisco
storyline.beat: Natasha moves to San Francisco with Daredevil, and for a stretch his comic is retitled Daredevil and the Black Widow.

storyline.title: Team leader
storyline.beat: She leads the Champions, a short-lived Los Angeles hero team featuring Hercules, Ghost Rider, Angel and Iceman.

storyline.title: Yelena Belova
storyline.beat: A miniseries pits Natasha against Yelena Belova, a younger graduate of the same spy program who wants the Black Widow name for herself.

gossip.text: Black Widow has always been one of the good guys.
gossip.truth: She debuted in 1964 as a Soviet spy villain sent after Iron Man and only later became a hero.

gossip.text: Her iconic black catsuit did not show up until 1970, six years after her debut.
Emily Blunt was first lined up to play Natasha in Iron Man 2 but had to drop out over scheduling, opening the door for Scarlett Johansson.
She dated Daredevil, and the comic was renamed Daredevil and the Black Widow while they were partners.
Her long life and slowed aging are explained in the comics by a Soviet version of the super-soldier treatment.

quiz.q: Which hero was Natasha first sent to target?
quiz.why: She debuted in Tales of Suspense as a spy sent against Tony Stark.

quiz.q: Which archer did she lure into crime early on?
quiz.why: Clint Barton fell for her and briefly fought Iron Man.

quiz.q: Which 1970s Los Angeles team did she lead?
quiz.why: She led the Champions from 1975 to 1978.

theme.tagline: Already three moves ahead of you.

timeline.title: A Soviet spy targets Stark
timeline.note: Tales of Suspense #52 sends Natasha after Iron Man as a glamorous Cold War saboteur with no costume yet.

timeline.title: Meet the archer
timeline.note: Tales of Suspense #57 pairs her with Hawkeye, a rookie she draws into crime before both switch sides.

timeline.title: The iconic black catsuit
timeline.note: The Amazing Spider-Man #86 gives Natasha the sleek black outfit and wrist stingers that define her look to this day.

timeline.title: Partners in Daredevil
timeline.note: Daredevil #81 starts her long run beside Matt Murdock, and soon the book is renamed for both of them.

timeline.title: Leading the Champions
timeline.note: The Champions launches with Natasha in charge of a West Coast team that includes Hercules and Ghost Rider.

timeline.title: A rival Widow appears
timeline.note: Yelena Belova debuts in Inhumans #5 as a younger graduate of the Red Room who wants the Widow name for herself.

timeline.title: Scarlett Johansson suits up
timeline.note: Iron Man 2 introduces Scarlett Johansson's Natasha, the start of a decade-long run through the MCU.

timeline.title: Her own movie at last
timeline.note: Black Widow finally gives Natasha a solo film, and passes the torch to Florence Pugh as Yelena.
